metadata.name: collection-list-declarative
metadata.description: Verify declarative collection fields, pointer and keyboard open ports, explicit query filtering, and phone overflow.

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-collection-key="support"]'); if(!r.textContent.includes('Maya:')||!r.textContent.includes('In-app'))throw Error('Declarative fields missing');if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>window.innerWidth+1)throw Error('Horizontal overflow');for (const v of document.querySelectorAll('[data-rcl-virtual-list-viewport]')) {if(v.scrollWidth>v.clientWidth)throw Error('Nested list overflow '+v.scrollWidth+' > '+v.clientWidth);} return true})()

(()=>{if(!document.querySelector('[data-opened]').textContent.includes('Opened Support escalation'))throw Error('Open port not called');const input=document.querySelector('input');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(input,'Operations');input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return true})()

(()=>{const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-rcl-collection-key]')];if(rows.length!==1||rows[0].dataset.rclCollectionKey!=='operations')throw Error('Query did not select the matching row');rows[0].focus();rows[0].dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true}));return true})()
(()=>{if(!document.querySelector('[data-opened]').textContent.includes('Opened Operations handoff'))throw Error('Keyboard open failed');return true})()
